about: Recorded pull-request history of the ledger repository, replayed with `harvest github --from`. `result` is the whole harvest the replay must print; `noise` lists what the history holds that must not count.

evidence.author: mlefevre
evidence.text: a list endpoint is paginated with `limit` and `cursor`; it never returns a whole table.

evidence.author: mlefevre
evidence.text: Fix 'fix: cap the transfers page at 100 rows' on files of agent PR #42 (Add GET /accounts/{id}/transfers) 23 h after its merge

noise.why: a dependency bot's PR (branch renovate/): its [bot] login does not make it an agent PR, and it is no recurring task
the squash commit of the dependency bot's PR: a bot's commit corrects no agent PR
a review nit said once: no `rule:` prefix, and nothing recurs on a second PR
the agent's answer says 'the rule:' in the middle of a sentence: only a comment that starts with `rule:` is one
one commit follows this review within the hour, not the three that make a burst
the lint check fails on a single agent PR: an ignored guardrail is one that fails on two
a `rule:` comment written on 2026-10-01, before the window opens on 2026-10-15, on a PR updated since
a reviewer's question on a human PR, asked once
a human commit 22 hours after the agent PR's merge that touches none of its files
a human fix eight days after the merge: outside the 48-hour window of an after-the-fact correction
a merge commit of a release branch: it brings in work done elsewhere
the squash commit of the agent PR itself
